description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing Supabase authentication state and actions in a React application. It includes functions for initializing auth, signing in, signing up, password reset, updating user password, and signing out.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes auth listeners and fetches the current session; sets up auth state change listener.

methods.name: signInWithPassword
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password, updates store state.

methods.name: signUpWithEmail
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, sends email verification link.

methods.name: resetPasswordForEmail
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the specified address.

methods.name: updateUserPassword
methods.description: Updates the current user's password after a recovery redirect.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user and resets auth state.
